label: TEST DATA — Session review save recovery
acceptanceDefinedBeforeChanges: Commit a local checklist run then lose its response; reconcile exact operation through UI with one receipt/version/audit. Repeat for owner observation. Distinguish confirmed POST/failed GET; check payload conflicts, owner/capability gates, persistence and interrupted/repeated navigation.

baselineReproduction.name: baseline defect reproduced: committed run loses UI operation and review

method: Fresh owned headless Chrome; actual built React UI, loopback Node API and Python worker; isolated owner-bound SQLite. Existing synthetic selected-record fixture only. A browser route let the real POST commit before discarding its response; a separate route failed the following GET after acknowledged POST. Direct read-only SQLite snapshots checked reviews, operations and mutation audit. Synthetic authentication principal; no production identity claim.

Node REPL crypto getter rejected one request-ID construction before any request executed; used node:crypto randomUUID and continued.

limits: Recovery envelope exists only in the mounted Session review view. Leaving/reloading loses it; no automatic replay or browser-storage persistence.
Exact reconciliation is a POST, not a read-only operation lookup. It may execute an uncommitted operation under current server gates.
A definitive rejection during replay does not settle an earlier uncertain attempt; the envelope remains pending.
No multi-tab or cross-device recovery guarantee; fresh reads and server version checks remain necessary.
Owner observations remain owner reported; checklist receipts cover bounded declarative checks only. No transcript completeness/authorship certification or external agent execution.
No private logs, shared/production database, provider calls, deployment or actual-user production authentication validation.
Only listed targeted workflows and existing checks were performed; prior owner-review report evidence remains historical.
nextTask: Review the draft PR. Consider a separately scoped read-only operation-status contract if recovery must survive leaving the view without persisting sensitive payloads in browser storage.

designFollowups.outcome: Recover evidence for the original attempt after reload without storing private request payloads in the browser or automatically resubmitting.
designFollowups.inspection: Compared four existing mounted recovery flows, shared and companion operation stores, owner binding, digest schemes and read-only lookup gaps. Searched relevant existing documentation for duplicate durable-recovery contract.
designFollowups.recommendation: Read-only minimal receipt lookup first; later explicitly migrated/default-off server metadata registration for action claims only. No durable client payload or retry reconstruction.
